collection.execution: single prior actual collection reused; no replay

limits: Synthetic raw SQL rows are not native TaskResults or historical application execution.
No API M2 consumer, ResultQualification, native history, current freshness, emitter, public UDS product result, model, provider, account, target, installed runtime, r1 or global operation.
Close/reopen is attested SQL connection close/reopen, not server or runtime restart.
Readiness accepts/refuses schema shape; no functional PASS inferred.
Canonical make check final NOT_RUN; SOURCE prerequisites are not PostgreSQL results.

Raw pytest/owner logs and PGDATA content are potentially secret-bearing and excluded from content hashes; their retention/mode/physical file metadata is recorded. Private credential file is not serialized or hashed.
Unknown grammar, arbitrary epochs, future consumer behavior and physical crash/power loss are NOT_RUN.
